label.minimal_fix: Add WHERE bus_type = 'db' to the query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS db_bus_count FROM buses WHERE bus_type = 'db';
Replace AVG(d.generation_mw) with SUM(d.generation_mw) to compute total dispatched generation, not average.
Select branch_uid and continuous_rating_mva from branches where continuous_rating_mva > 550 order by continuous_rating_mva desc.
Replace MIN(nominal_kv) with MAX(nominal_kv) to return the highest nominal bus voltage.
Change the filter from 'Spin_Up_R1' to 'Spin_Up_R3' in the WHERE clause. Keep the date range and aggregation as is.
Replace MAX(available_mw) with AVG(available_mw) and alias as avg_available_mw. Keep the same filter and grouping.
Add WHERE clause: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loads WHERE active_power_mw > 0.4;
Replace MIN(load_mw) with MAX(load_mw) to compute the peak (maximum) load.
Change the WHERE clause to filter switch_type = 'LBS' instead of 'CB'.
Change the WHERE clause to filter reserve_product = 'Spin_Up_R1' instead of 'Spin_Up_R2'.
Add WHERE length_km > 0.5 to the query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines WHERE length_km > 0.5;
Select name and rated_power_mva from transformers, order by rated_power_mva DESC.
Replace AVG(rated_power_mva) with SUM(rated_power_mva) to compute the combined rated power.
Replace SELECT bus_id with voltage_level_code and group by voltage_level_code. Use COUNT(*) as bus_count.
Add JOIN with reserve_products to filter direction='spinning' (or eligible_device_subcategories='spinning') and select reserve_product instead of timestamp in SELECT and GROUP BY.
Add WHERE closed = 0 to count only open switches.
Remove fuel_price_usd_per_mmbtu from SELECT; include generator_uid or generator_id to identify the generators. Keep nonfuel_start_cost_usd and ORDER BY/LIMIT.
Replace MAX(active_power_mw) with AVG(active_power_mw) and keep ROUND(...,6) for the average.
Add WHERE length_km > 0.3 to the query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines WHERE length_km > 0.3;
Replace AVG(d.generation_mw) with SUM(d.generation_mw) to compute total dispatched generation.
